profile.headline: Software Engineer @ AcuityMD
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer passionate about solving complex problems through AI-driven automation, intelligent systems, and scalable engineering solutions. My expertise spans AI-powered automation, LLM integration, full-stack development, and testing infrastructure, allowing me to build end-to-end solutions that optimize workflows, enhance user experiences, and drive operational efficiency.

At Month2Month, I work across multiple domains to develop AI tools, spearhead automation initiatives, and enhance both internal and customer-facing systems. AI is at the core of my work, where I’ve built LLM-powered assistants using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to streamline internal processes and improve decision-making. I design intelligent automation systems that optimize everything from booking workflows and vendor management to operational analytics, allowing the company to scale efficiently across 17 states and 110 cities.

But beyond the technical, I thrive at the intersection of engineering and real-world impact. Technology should serve people, not the other way around. That’s why I love working cross-functionally—collaborating with stakeholders, gathering insights from real users, and engineering solutions that don’t just work, but make life easier, faster, and more efficient. Whether I’m building AI-powered tools to streamline operations, refining internal systems to help teams work smarter, or enhancing user experiences through AI-driven insights, my ultimate goal is to create technology that genuinely improves people’s lives.

My journey in AI and software engineering started with non-profits, where I built technology for organizations lacking the resources to modernize their systems. From there, I transitioned to working at scale, refining my expertise in React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, and backend architecture, as well as developing testing frameworks that ensure reliability and scalability. Through my experience, I’ve developed a deep passion for using AI not just as an enhancement, but as a fundamental driver of efficiency, automation, and intelligent decision-making.

I’m always excited to explore new ideas in AI, automation, and intelligent systems, and I enjoy connecting with others who are passionate about building technology that makes a real impact. Let’s connect and talk about AI-driven engineering, automation, and the future of intelligent systems!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, built, and launched a B2C housing search and application platform, transforming a previously B2B-only model into a direct-to-consumer channel and generating steady monthly leads.
- Architected SSR and SSG frameworks and implemented a Jest-based CI pipeline, improving site performance, test reliability, and SEO visibility—resulting in a 33% increase in search impressions.
- Refactored and maintained the internal Property Management System (PMS) built on Ruby on Rails, enhancing both frontend responsiveness and backend scalability while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
- Migrated legacy Ruby on Rails MVC architecture to a modular frontend-backend framework, redesigning RESTful APIs to boost system maintainability and support full-stack integration.
- Developed internal LLM assistants using Python, FastAPI, and Pydantic, incorporating a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to optimize company SOPs and significantly reduce AI training costs, while ensuring backend efficiency.
- Redesigned the Next.js inventory page and main landing page, using collected user data and stakeholder feedback to improve user experience and ease-of-use, boosting user engagement by 80%.
- Mentored three junior engineers, providing architectural guidance and defining project scopes aligned with quarterly engineering goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Spearheaded an agentic LLM marketing tool, designing and implementing a chatbot used by sales and marketing teams to identify and engage with leads across Reddit and TikTok.
- Streamlined vendor work order processes by creating an external task page with temporary authentication system.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed a web application for non-profit organization Cell Dogs using React.js, PostgreSQL, and Git version control allowing employees to efficiently track and assign up to 400 dogs and facilities.
•	Built and styled responsive components and pages using CSS from low-fi and high-fi wireframes.
•	Collaborated and worked closely with a team of 18 UI/UX designers and developers to efficiently implement features for every 2-week sprint through an agile development cycle, ensuring code quality with thorough code review processes through Github.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · PostgreSQL · React.js · HTML · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented scalable integration test infrastructure using Java TestNG, AWS S3 Buckets, AWS SQS, to contribute to the continuous deployment efforts for cloud service utilized by Amazon Astro, saving development and QA teams numerous days of testing to deploy services to production.
• Communicated and collaborated across several development and QA teams about dependencies in design and implementation of testing infrastructure ensuring the quality and longevity of infrastructure beyond internship.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon SQS · REST APIs · API Testing · TestNG · JSON

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Working with a team, I developed different projects as solutions to real world problems
- created a system to help those involved in the school community report issues
- a story-telling campaign that would help local businesses in San Leandro amidst Covid-19

positions.title: Project Developer
positions.description: Working with the employer of choice, Typeform, I built a project involving a solution to the issue of lack of outlets for reporting complaints and suggestions in schools.

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
- taught the fundamentals of programming through Python
- wrote and developed benchmark tests and curriculum pathway
